label: Price zone
gloss: price location against the channel of the 20 bars before this one, near an edge in its outer 20%

label: Demand zone average (prior Asia 00–08 UTC)
gloss: the zone's midpoint — halfway between its inner edge and the window low, on the demand zone of the previous completed Asia 00–08 UTC trading session (00:00–08:00 UTC): its range cut into 50 equal bins counted from the window low, each holding the volume of the 1m bars whose low lies in it, and the zone runs from the low to the first bin whose running share of the window's volume exceeds 10% — a BattleGrid variant of LuxAlgo “Supply and Demand Daily” (Intrabar TF 1m) over this session in place of the day; fixed once the window closes and absent until then; absent where the window has no range or no volume or no bin exceeds the threshold, and for a window that closed before these levels were first stored

supplyDemandThreshold.description: LuxAlgo’s Threshold %: the share of the window’s volume, counted in bins from its high (supply) or low (demand), a zone must exceed to end.

supplyDemandResolution.description: LuxAlgo’s Resolution: the equal bins the window’s range is cut into. Off its default the server rebuilds the window from its 1m bars, which reach only the last two UTC days.

label: Asia 00–08 UTC high (previous instance)

label: Asia 00–08 UTC high swept
gloss: whether any price since the previous Asia 00–08 UTC trading session closed has traded strictly above its high: swept, else intact — a touch is not a sweep; read live, because the last price decides; absent while that instance, any trading session since it, or the current one has no fold, or the last price is unknown
